glossary.definition:
(D) For purposes of this section, "claim" includes an unliquidated claim, but does not include either of the following:

(1) A contingent liability that has not matured so that there is no immediate right to bring suit;

(2) A claim based on an event occurring after the effective date of dissolution.

(E) Nothing in this section shall be construed to extend any otherwise applicable statute or period of limitations.
glossary.source_title: Section 1706.473 - Claims against dissolved limited liability company.
